title: Eat Your Precision: Precision Objective Mitigates Reward Hacking in Rubric-based RL
abstract: arXiv:2610.33512v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rubric-based rewards enable effective reinforcement learning on non-verifiable tasks. However, because these rewards are typically defined as a weighted measure of rubric coverage, models are trained primarily to maximize a recall objective. As a result, RL-trained models produce responses that are more complete but also more verbose and contain more unnecessary or factually incorrect content, leading them to be less preferred than responses from the base model. To address this issue, we present the FORK reward, which jointly optimizes recall and a novel precision objective, which requires each unit of a model response to be both necessary and factually correct, as measured by rubric-driven necessity credits and a factual-correctness grader, respectively. Our experimental results show that FORK outperforms existing rubric-based RL methods and achieves Pareto-optimal performance that balances rubric coverage and overall response quality.

translated_title: 重视精确率：精确率目标缓解基于评分标准的强化学习中的奖励作弊问题
translated_abstract: 基于评分标准的奖励使强化学习能够在不可验证的任务上有效进行。然而，由于这些奖励通常被定义为评分标准覆盖率的加权度量，模型主要被训练去最大化召回率目标。因此，经强化学习训练的模型生成的回复虽然更加完整，但也更加冗长，并包含更多不必要或事实错误的内容，导致这些回复不如基础模型的回复受人青睐。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了FORK奖励，它联合优化召回率和一个新颖的精确率目标，该目标要求模型回复的每个单元既必要又事实正确，分别通过基于评分标准的必要性评分和事实正确性评估器来衡量。实验结果表明，FORK优于现有的基于评分标准的强化学习方法，并实现了平衡评分标准覆盖率与整体回复质量的帕累托最优性能。
tldr: 提出FORK奖励，通过联合优化召回率与新颖的精确率目标，缓解基于评分标准的强化学习中的奖励作弊问题，使模型回复既完整又不冗长且事实正确。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the FORK reward, which jointly optimizes recall and a novel precision objective to mitigate reward hacking in rubric-based RL, yielding responses that are complete yet concise and factually accurate.
